author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 2; ensure at least four current turns classified as order_logistics across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer ordered a desk lamp but the package shows delivered while they never received it.

messages.content: Hi, I ordered the LED desk lamp last week. Tracking says delivered yesterday but I never got it.
I'm sorry to hear that. Let me check the delivery scan for you. Can you confirm your order number?
Sure, it's #48291. The carrier photo shows a doorstep but that's not my house.
Thank you. I've flagged this with the carrier. They'll investigate within 48 hours. Is there anything else I can help with meanwhile?

variants.text: Actually, forget the investigation. Just send me a replacement lamp to my office address instead.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Thanks for flagging it. Also, do you know if this lamp works with a dimmer switch?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Can I speak to a supervisor about this? I'm really frustrated with the delivery service.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer bought running shoes two months ago and the sole is peeling.

messages.content: I bought the TrailBlazer running shoes in March. The sole is coming apart already.
I'm sorry about that. Our shoes carry a 6-month manufacturing warranty. Could you share a photo of the damage?
Here's the photo. You can see the glue just gave up along the toe area.
Thanks, I can see the issue clearly. I'll process a warranty claim for you. You'll get a prepaid return label by email shortly.

variants.text: Wait, before you send the label — can I just get a partial store credit instead of returning them?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Great, I'll watch for the label. By the way, are these shoes supposed to be waterproof?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, I'd rather exchange them for a half size up. Can you arrange that instead?
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer asks about a coffee maker they saw but is unsure about the model.

messages.content: I'm looking at the espresso machine on your site — the silver one around $200.
That sounds like our BaristaPro 300. It has a 15-bar pump and a milk frother. Would you like more details?
Yes, does it come with a grinder built in, or do I need to buy one separately?
The BaristaPro 300 does not include a grinder. We do sell a matching conical burr grinder separately for $79.

variants.text: Okay, I'll take the machine and the grinder. Can you ship both to my home address?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Hmm, actually I think I saw a different model with a grinder. Let me double-check the page.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Thanks. Also, is there a way to track my existing order #7731? It's been quiet for a few days.
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer's subscription order for pet food was charged twice this month.

messages.content: I noticed my card was charged twice for the monthly cat food subscription.
I apologize for that. Let me pull up your subscription account. Could you confirm the email on file?
It's jane.k@mail.com. Both charges were for $34.99 on the same day.
I see the duplicate charge. I'll initiate a refund for one of them right away — it should appear in 3-5 business days.

variants.text: Perfect, thank you. And while you're at it, can you skip next month's delivery? I'll be traveling.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, don't refund it — just apply the extra payment as credit toward next month's order.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Thanks. By the way, is the salmon flavor formula okay for kittens under one year?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer wants to change the delivery address for an order placed yesterday.

messages.content: I just placed order #9023 for a yoga mat and blocks. I realized I'm moving next week.
I understand. Since the order hasn't shipped yet, we can update the address. What's the new one?
It's 45 Maple Street, Apt 3B, Portland. Also, can you add the carrying strap to this order?
I've updated the address and added the strap. Your total will increase by $12. The order ships tomorrow.

variants.text: Hold on — I changed my mind about the strap. Please remove it and keep just the mat and blocks.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Great. Also, I forgot my password and can't log in to check the order status. Can you help?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Actually, cancel the whole order. I found a better deal elsewhere.
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer received a damaged ceramic vase and wants to resolve it.

messages.content: My vase arrived cracked. The box looked fine but the vase has a hairline fracture.
Oh no, I'm sorry. We'll make this right. Would you prefer a replacement or a full refund?
I'd like a replacement since it's a gift for my sister's wedding.
Understood. I'll ship a replacement today and email you the return label for the damaged one.

variants.text: Actually, the wedding got postponed, so just refund me instead of sending a replacement.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Thanks. Do you have gift wrapping available for the replacement?
variants.label: general

variants.text: Can you also check if the matching set of coasters is back in stock? I want to order those too.
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer is locked out of their account after changing phone number.

messages.content: I can't log in — the two-factor code goes to my old phone number.
I can help verify your identity another way. Could you confirm the last four digits of the card on file?
It ends in 4417. I also remember my order history includes a blender from January.
Thanks, that matches. I'll update your phone number now. You should receive a confirmation text shortly.

variants.text: Got the text, thanks. Also, my last order never arrived — can you look into order #5510?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, I don't need the account anymore. Can you close it and delete my data?
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Thanks for your help. Have a great day!
variants.label: general

families.scenario: Customer asks about return policy for an opened electronic item.

messages.content: I opened my wireless headphones and they don't fit my ears well. Can I still return them?
Since they're opened, they fall under our 30-day return policy with a 15% restocking fee for electronics.
Hmm, that fee seems steep. Is there any way to waive it if I exchange for a different model?
For exchanges, we can waive the restocking fee as long as the new item is of equal or greater value.

variants.text: Alright, I'll exchange them for the over-ear model. Can you start that process?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, I think I'll just keep them and buy some different ear tips instead. Thanks anyway.
variants.label: general

variants.text: Before I decide — do the over-ear ones have active noise cancellation?
variants.label: product_technical
